constraint.description: Jackson default typing allows polymorphic deserialization gadgets (remote code execution): use an explicit PolymorphicTypeValidator or @JsonTypeInfo.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(rt:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND (rt.fqn = 'com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper' AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) IN ['activateDefaultTyping', 'enableDefaultTyping', 'activateDefaultTypingAsProperty']) RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, rt.fqn + '#' + coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) AS Detail
